rules: Corpse creation transfers only non-container top-level items not explicitly projected death-protected.
death_protected and no_drop_on_death are evidence-gated metadata inputs; absent metadata never implies protection.
Partial corpse loot is legal only for projected stackable definitions and a positive quantity not exceeding the corpse stack.
A partial loot preserves the corpse source instance ID, creates one transferred instance ID, then applies owner limits and destination-stack reconciliation atomically.
Nested portable containers are never partially looted because container definitions are not stack-split by this policy.
safe_fallbacks: unknown death flags do not activate protection
invalid partial requests leave corpse and destination state unchanged
